title: Good experience with guide

He was able to guide us with a perfect mixture of passion, knowledge and closeness that made every corner come alive. We learned, enjoyed and laughed as we discovered details and curiosities that we would not have known on our own. It was a complete, entertaining and very special experience, which turned our walk through the city into something unforgettable. title: Anecdote, curiosities and a great knowledge of Seville through his passion
text: Laura discovered Seville from her passionate knowledge of architecture and art. The anecdotes, legends and passion made our visit a great experience in the city. We spent our time flying and are looking forward to re-arranging a visit and continue discovering more of Seville. 100% recommended!!
author: josefaa197

title: A wonderful and informative tour.
text: Laura was absolutely fantastic. She not only showed us the highlights of Sevilla but also gave us a wonderful insight into the history and origin of every landmark and area. Her knowledge was remarkable. We would recommend her to anyone.
author: markhG5772EZ

title: Highly stimulating tour of Seville
text: Super interesting and entertaining tour by our guideValentin. He was truly fantastic in explaining all the historical details, making it entertaining and interesting, and all of this in the space of no more than two hours. In addition, Valentin had fantastic restaurant recommendations. The resto we went to was the culinary highlight of our stay in Seville. Highly recommended!
